# Vendor CAD (not committed — 27 MB, re-downloadable)

The design references these third-party models, kept locally in the
Fusion working folder (`C:\Projects\PyPortal Pynt-RTK\enclosure\vendor\`):

- `pyportal_pynt_4465.step` / `.stl` — Adafruit PyPortal Pynt (#4465),
  github.com/adafruit/Adafruit-PyPortal-PCB
- `simpleRTK2B_Lite-00.step` — ArduSimple simpleRTK2B Lite, ardusimple.com
- `ardusimple_usbc_carrier.step` (`AS-ADP-USBC-TO-XBEE-00`) — ArduSimple
